SEBI Legal 2025 Study Plan for Working Professionals  
Key points to note:  
✔ The Study Plan given below focuses on Phase I (Paper 1 and Paper 2) and Phase II (Paper  
1 and Paper 2) preparation  
✔ Time commitment required ideally: 3-4 hours on weekdays and 7-8 hours on weekends (this  
may vary as per the preparation level and understanding of the student)  
✔ Study GA on a daily basis from BeePeedia and the GA content provided in your course and  
Follow one newspaper – Devote 1 hour  
✔ Study English or Reasoning or Quantitative Aptitude over the weekend.  
✔ Study Law subjects for 3-4 hours daily  
Actionables:  
✔ At the end of each day, do analyse your whole day and make plan for the next day  
✔ Sunday should be revision day for you. You can also write a mock test. Analyse the tests  
you have attempted, and first focus on the questions which you answered incorrectly and  
then focus on all un-attempted questions - in each section.  
✔ If Descriptive English is your weak area, read at least one editorial article daily from an  
English Newspaper. If you are good in descriptive English, you may skip this and practice  
writing essay, precis and RC questions.  
✔ Practise Puzzles / Seating Arrangement and also the Data Interpretation / Caselet DI daily.  
Depending on the availability of time, you may do it on alternate days or may keep a gap of  
two days also depending on the availability of time and your present level.  
✔ Daily revise previous day’s work.
